coverage_summary: Primary-source scan examined EIA November energy forecast and World Bank grid-financing framework and existing Asia DRIVE / Uzbekistan projects. November 10 World Bank discussion identifies a global transmission financing gap, not a newly executed country-specific project or verified accessible economic opportunity. No independent evidence of new disbursement, commissioning, regulatory implementation or capacity addition. No candidate invented.

sources_checked.name: World Bank Transmission Impossible: financing the grid
World Bank Japan DRIVE Asia energy resilience

review_limitations: World Bank discussion's estimated annual transmission financing requirement is not evidence of newly disbursed financing or installed assets.
Existing DRIVE and Uzbekistan candidates not duplicated; no material verified transition.
No comprehensive global census of projects, grid queues, logistics, regulation or private capital completed.
